author: PostOakLabs
description: For one declared trade, check which post-trade step breaks only under T+1, whether each allocation and confirmation event met the 23:00 CET trade-date rule in machine-readable form, and whether declared FX funding legs make every cutoff for the same declared settle date. The timing panel follows art-506, the allocation panel follows art-81, and the funding panel follows art-672, all over one trade record entered once with its UTC offset. Runs entirely in the browser, zero network, zero storage, deterministic.

at_risk_margin_seconds.description: At-risk band in seconds for the timing panel, 0 means no at-risk band, default 3600

baseline_cycle.description: Baseline settlement cycle label, default T+2

confirm_time_local.description: Trade confirmation time in HH:MM on trade_date in the declared local zone, converted to UTC for the funding panel

cutoff_local.description: Allocation and confirmation cutoff in HH:MM local CET time, default 23:00

events.description: Allocation and confirmation events, one object per row, each with event_type, time_local in HH:MM CET on trade_date, format, counterparty_type

legs.description: Declared FX funding legs, one object per currency, each with ccy as a 3-letter uppercase currency code and cutoff_utc in HH:MM UTC

settle_date.description: Declared settle date in YYYY-MM-DD, caller-declared, not computed from trade_date and cycle because no business-day calendar is shipped

steps.description: Post-trade steps, one object per step, each with step, achieved_local, cutoff_target_local and cutoff_baseline_local as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM datetimes in the declared local zone

target_cycle.description: Target settlement cycle label, default T+1

trade_date.description: Trade date in YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date in the declared local zone

trade_ref.description: Opaque trade reference, caller-supplied, no personal data

trade_time_local.description: Trade execution time in HH:MM on trade_date in the declared local zone

utc_offset_minutes.description: Minutes east of UTC for the declared local zone, for example 60 for CET in winter and 120 for CEST in summer, applied to every local time to derive UTC

venue_cutoff_local.description: Venue cutoff datetime in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the declared local zone for the trade execution step

mcp_tool_definition.description: Checks one declared trade across three panels: post-trade step timing under a target cycle versus a baseline cycle per art-506, allocation and confirmation conformance against the 23:00 CET trade-date machine-readable rule per art-81, and FX funding sequencing against declared UTC cutoffs for one settle date per art-672, all derived from one trade record with a declared UTC offset.
